content: A lannae hoi yuemkamcunae dawk Cathut pholennae

content.text: BAWIPA teh pholen awh.
Tami kalannaw kamkhuengnae koe, maya um vah,
BAWIPA teh ka lungthin abuemlahoi ka pholen han.
BAWIPA ni a sak e thaw teh a len.
Ka ngai e pueng ni teh a kamtu awh.
A tawk e teh bari a kamcu teh, a sungren.
A lannae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Kângairu hno a sak e teh a yungyoe panue hanelah a sak.
BAWIPA teh pahrennae hoi lungmanae hoi ka kawi e doeh.
Ama ka taketnaw hah rawca ca hane a poe.
A lawkkam teh nâtuek hai pahnim hoeh.
Miphunnaw e râw hah a miphunnaw a poe teh,
a taminaw koe a tawk e thaonae hah a pâpho pouh.
A kut hoi sak e naw teh lawkkatang hoi lannae lah ao.
Phunglawknaw teh yuem a kamcu.
Hotnaw teh a yungyoe hoi a yungyoe a kangning han.
Hotnaw teh lawkkatang hoi lannae hoi sak e lah ao.
A taminaw koe ratangnae hah a patawn teh,
a lawkkam teh a yungyoe a kangning nahanlah, kâ a poe.
A min teh a thoung, taki a tho.
BAWIPA taki e heh lungang kamtawngnae lah ao.
Kâpoelawknaw katarawinaw ni thaipanueknae kahawi a tawn.
Pholennae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
